declare

begin
 nullchk;

 from ltapi.api_lt_conversion
 where source_appl_id = :ctrl_block.c_source_id

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FROM_TO_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/**************************************************************
* check wfrom date is less than to date
-- Y2k checked by Edwin on 05/25/99
**************************************************************/

FUNCTION Check_From_To_date(date_from date, date_to date ) RETURN boolean IS
BEGIN
 if to_char(date_from,'YYYY-MM-DD')>
 to_char(date_to,'YYYY-MM-DD') then
 return FALSE; 
 else
 return TRUE; 
 end if; 
RETURN NULL; END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_DB_REC_CHK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DUP_DB_REC_CHK IS

counter NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 if :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value is not null and
 :API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value is not null and 
 :API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value_type is not null then
 begin
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM LTAPI.API_LT_CONVERSION
 WHERE UPPER(source_value) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value)))
 AND UPPER(target_value) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value)))
 AND UPPER(target_value_type) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value_type)))
 AND UPPER(source_appl_id) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:ctrl_block.c_source_id)))
 AND UPPER(target_appl_id) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:ctrl_block.c_target_id)));
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if UPPER(:system.record_status) in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED') then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 
END;

PROCEDURE DUP_DB_SRC_CHK IS

counter NUMBER := 0;

BEGIN
 if :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value is not null and
 :API_LT_CONVERSION.eff_date is not null then
 begin
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM LTAPI.API_LT_CONVERSION
 WHERE UPPER(source_appl_id) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:ctrl_block.c_source_id)))
 AND UPPER(target_appl_id) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:ctrl_block.c_target_id)))
 AND UPPER(source_value) = upper(ltrim(rtrim(:API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value)))
 AND trunc(:API_LT_CONVERSION.eff_date) <= trunc(nvl(term_date, :API_LT_CONVERSION.eff_date + 1))
 AND trunc(nvl(:API_LT_CONVERSION.term_date, eff_date + 1)) >= trunc(eff_date); 
 --trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(eff_date) AND trunc(nvl(term_date, sysdate + 2) - 1);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 if UPPER(:system.record_status) in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED') then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 show_error('0319');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
This procedure will be used to check the duplicate records - 
The program will prevent enteries if the source value, target value, target code type are the same 
*/
PROCEDURE DUP_RECORD_CHECK IS


counter number(10);
src_counter number(10);
rec_num number(10);
--variables to store values in
v_source_value varchar2(50);
v_target_value varchar2(50);
v_target_value_type varchar2(50);
--v_source_value_type varchar2(50);
v_source_id varchar2(50);
v_target_id varchar2(50);
v_eff_date date;
v_term_date date;

v_no_of_rec number(10);
curr_rec number(10);
BEGIN

go_block('API_LT_CONVERSION');
last_record;
v_no_of_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track # of records in the block for loop
first_record;--return to first rec
for i in 1 .. v_no_of_rec loop 
curr_rec := :system.cursor_record; --track which rec we left off at

 v_source_id := :ctrl_block.c_source_id;
 v_target_id := :ctrl_block.c_target_id;
-- v_source_value_type := :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value_type;
 v_source_value := :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value;
 v_target_value := :API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value;
 v_target_value_type := :API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value_type;
 v_eff_date := :API_LT_CONVERSION.eff_date;
 v_term_date := :API_LT_CONVERSION.term_date;
 
 first_record;--to compare thru the whole block for dups
 counter := 0;
 src_counter := 0;
 loop 
 if :ctrl_block.c_source_id = v_source_id and
 :ctrl_block.c_target_id = v_target_id and
-- :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value_type = v_source_value_type and
 :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value = v_source_value and
 :API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value = v_target_value and
 :API_LT_CONVERSION.target_value_type = v_target_value_type then

 counter := counter + 1;
 end if;
 
 if :API_LT_CONVERSION.source_value = v_source_value and
 trunc(:API_LT_CONVERSION.eff_date) <= trunc(nvl(v_term_date, :API_LT_CONVERSION.eff_date + 1)) and
 trunc(nvl(:API_LT_CONVERSION.term_date, v_eff_date + 1)) >= trunc(v_eff_date) then

 src_counter := src_counter + 1;
 end if;
 exit when :system.cursor_record = v_no_of_rec;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 if counter > 1 or src_counter > 1 then 
 BELL;
 go_record(curr_rec);
 show_error('0319'); 
 end if;

go_record(curr_rec+1); --back to the rec we left off at + 1- sort of next record 

end loop;

first_record;


end;
